test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five men and 2 boys can do in 30 days as much work as 7 men and 10 boys can do in 15 days. How many boys should join 40 men to do the same work in 4 days?
solution:
Given:

5 men and 2 boys can do a work in 30 days

7 men and 10 boys can do the same work in 15 days

Concept used:

Time = Work/Efficiency

Calculation:

Let, M = Men; B = Boys

(5M + 2B) × 30 = (7M + 10B) × 15

⇒ 150M + 60B = 105M + 150B

⇒ 150M - 105M = 150B - 60B

⇒ 45M = 90B

⇒ M/B = 90/45 = 2/1

So, the efficiency of one man = 2

Efficiency of one boy = 1

Total work = [(5 × 2) + (2 × 1)] × 30 = 12 × 30 = 360

Efficiency of 40 men = 40 × 2 = 80

Time required to finish work = 4 days

Now, 360/(80 + B) = 4

⇒ 90 = 80 + B

⇒ B = 90 - 80 = 10

**∴ The total number of 10 boys should join to do the work**
